video.en: I got a video cassette recorder cheap at that shop.
video.zh: 我在那商店花低价买了台录像机。

visitor.en: She's a frequent visitor to this country.

vacation.en: Tom intends to play tennis every day during his summer vacation.
vacation.zh: 汤姆打算暑假每天打网球。

visa.en: We were disappointed to hear that Tom couldn't get a visa.
visa.zh: 我们很遗憾地听说，汤姆没能拿到签证。

victory.en: They congratulated us on our victory.

voice.en: Tom always speaks in such a low voice that I can barely understand what he says.
voice.zh: 汤姆总是说话声音太小，我几乎听不懂他在说什么。

violin.en: You should practice playing the violin every day.
violin.zh: 你应该每天练习拉小提琴。

vote.en: In the U.S., most people can vote when they reach eighteen years of age.
vote.zh: 在美国，大多数人能在十八岁以后投票。

vision.en: My vision is getting worse these days.
vision.zh: 这些天我的视力正在变差。

vase.en: You need to put more water in the vase.
vase.zh: 你需要往花瓶里加更多的水。

volleyball.en: Some people like volleyball, others enjoy tennis.
volleyball.zh: 有些人喜欢排球，其他人喜欢网球。

vague.en: She had a vague feeling of guilt.
vague.zh: 她隐约地有一种的内疚感。

veteran.zh: 汤姆是一个越军退役军人。

vacuum.en: I got this vacuum cleaner for nothing.
vacuum.zh: 我免费得到了这个吸尘器。

variety.en: We talked about a variety of topics.

volume.en: Turn the volume up so that the students at the back can hear.
volume.zh: 声音大声一点，以便让坐在后边的学生能听到。

view.en: As we went around the corner, the lake came into view.
view.zh: 当我们走到转角处，湖就映入了眼帘。

vast.en: The Sahara is a vast desert.

value.en: The value of the coins depended on the weight of the metal used.
value.zh: 钱币的价值取决于所使用的金属的重量。

valuable.en: Neither Tom nor Mary has found anything valuable.
valuable.zh: 汤姆和玛丽都没有发现什么有价值的东西。

vain.en: He endeavored to make his wife happy, but in vain.
vain.zh: 他试著想让他妻子开心，但是没有成功。

vitamin.en: Carrots contain a lot of vitamin A.
vitamin.zh: 胡萝卜中含有大量的维生素A。

van.en: Tom was the last one to get in the van.
van.zh: 汤姆是最后一个上面包车的。

various.en: Japan imports various raw materials from abroad.
various.zh: 日本从国外进口各种原料。

verge.en: The poor child was on the verge of starvation.
verge.zh: 那可怜的孩子快饿死了。

vary.en: Social customs vary from country to country.

volcano.en: The volcano has become active again.
volcano.zh: 这座火山又开始活动了。

valid.en: It's valid until March thirty-first, nineteen-ninety-seven.

verse.en: He translated the verse into English.

vulgar.en: She is extremely vulgar in her speech.

vacant.en: There were several rooms still vacant.

voyage.en: Mary went on a voyage around the world.

victim.en: The victim died at a hospital in Boston.
victim.zh: 受害者在医院里死去了。

verify.en: I can verify that that's the truth myself.
verify.zh: 我自己能够证实那是真的。

version.en: This dictionary isn't the most recent version.
version.zh: 这本字典不是最新版的。

verb.en: A sentence normally has a subject and a verb.
verb.zh: 句子通常有主词和动词。

vocabulary.en: You need a large vocabulary to read that book.
vocabulary.zh: 你读那本书需要大量词汇。

valley.en: They marched northwest into the Shenandoah Valley.
valley.zh: 他们向西北方向进军，进入了谢南多厄河谷。

vice.en: They nominated Calvin Coolidge for vice president.
vice.zh: 他们提名卡尔文•柯立芝为副总统。

visible.en: Tom rolled up his trouser legs, making his bright red socks visible.
visible.zh: 汤姆卷起裤管，露出鲜红的袜子。
